dict.string: QTerm uses Touch ID to confirm it is you before replaying a recording you protected.
QTerm needs access to your Desktop folder so commands you run in the terminal can read and write files there.
QTerm needs access to your Documents folder so commands you run in the terminal can read and write files there.
QTerm needs access to your Downloads folder so commands you run in the terminal can read and write files there.
QTerm needs access to network volumes so commands you run in the terminal can read and write files on them.
QTerm needs access to removable volumes so commands you run in the terminal can read and write files on them.
